messages:
deploybot: Hotfix deploy request for embed-worker (image: emb-hotfix-0326). Canary in eu1 reported intermittent 503s for tokenizer path. Requesting expedited approval to roll to eu1 prod. Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/9123

alex: brief summary? what changed in the build, any config flips, blast radius?

deploybot: Change: add nil-check in tokenizer to avoid panics when input token array is empty (PR #5555). No config or infra changes. Targeting eu1 only.

ops-lee: I'm oncall. Auto-abort rule set: abort stage if 503s > 5% sustained for 3m. Manual rollback cmd: `releasebot rollback embed-worker v1.9.4 --region eu1`. Who will run manual rollback if auto-abort misses it?

maria: product ack. CS is impacted; we want the fix live ASAP. I'll draft the customer blurb once rollout completes.

alex: +1 infra pending release notes and pin.

releasebot: Draft relnotes: "embed-worker: guard against empty token arrays in tokenizer that caused occasional 503s under specific request patterns. Backported to v1.9.5-embfix. Pinned tag emb-hotfix-0326 -> v1.9.5-embfix." Confirm to pin?

ops-lee: relnote and pin ok. saving manual rollback command in channel.

deploybot: Approvals recorded: alex, maria, ops-lee. Executing expedited rollout: stages 30% -> 100% with 180s checks. Skipping low-traffic 5% canary due to customer impact.

deploybot: COMMAND: `deploy --svc embed-worker --img emb-hotfix-0326 --strategy expedited --region eu1 --stages 30,100 --wait 180s`

deploybot: 30% stage: success. Monitoring 180s.

ops-lee: watching metrics, no spike in CPU. small dip in 503s.

deploybot: 100% stage: success. No abort triggered. Metrics: 503s down to baseline ~0.8% from 14% peak.

maria: Verified. CS timeline note: incident peak 14% 503s, fix deployed in ~12m; updating ticket.

releasebot: Rollout complete. Release notes pinned and ticket closed. Follow-up: add short RCA to relnotes and link to PR #5555.
